def factor_volume_regime_ema_adaptive_momentum(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    weighted_ret = ret * vol_ratio
    ewm_wt_ret_5 = weighted_ret.ewm(span=5, adjust=False).mean()
    ewm_vol_5 = vol_ratio.ewm(span=5, adjust=False).mean()
    factor_5 = ewm_wt_ret_5 / ewm_vol_5.replace(0, np.nan)
    ewm_wt_ret_20 = weighted_ret.ewm(span=20, adjust=False).mean()
    ewm_vol_20 = vol_ratio.ewm(span=20, adjust=False).mean()
    factor_20 = ewm_wt_ret_20 / ewm_vol_20.replace(0, np.nan)
    weight = np.clip((vol_ratio - 1) * 2.0, 0, 1)
    factor = weight * factor_5 + (1 - weight) * factor_20
    df_copy["factor_volume_regime_ema_adaptive_momentum"] = factor.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_volume_regime_ema_adaptive_momentum"]
description: EMA-smoothed volume-regime adaptive momentum: replaces rolling sum with exponential moving average for the volume-weighted returns and volume normalization. EMA better captures recent volume information and reduces equal-weight window noise. The core mechanism remains blending short (span=5) and long (span=20) volume-weighted momentum based on continuous volume ratio weight. This preserves the parent's smooth regime adaptation and rank stability while targeting improved IC through noise reduction.
